probe.question: Give me a consolidated status across all active projects for the Monday leadership meeting — where each one stands, what moved last week, and what is blocked.
forbids_claims: a date, owner or state for any programme the mirror does not hold
what changed since last week, or any statement of movement over time
a percentage complete, a forecast, or a revised delivery date
that this is the whole of the group's work
probe.direction: Two of the three things asked for are now answerable and one is not. The commitment mirror holds what each programme has committed to, who owns it, what state it is in and when it is due — so "where each one stands" and "what is blocked" are real, with the blocked state being a first-class one rather than an inference. What it cannot do is say what *moved*: it is a snapshot that converges on the source's current state, so there is no previous state to diff. The answer must also lead with `mirrored_at` — a mirror's characteristic failure is being stale rather than wrong, and a manager acting on last month's picture is exactly the harm. Two boundaries to state plainly: this reflects the portfolio system rather than replacing it, so no date here is a commitment being made now and nothing may be re-forecast; and it holds only what was mirrored, so it is not the whole of the group's work. The genuinely valuable part of a good answer is the join the portfolio tool cannot make — which blocked items name notes, jobs or compounds, and therefore what chemistry is holding them up.
